entities.name: Andrea Kuklová

entities.summary: Andrea Kuklová is a former Slovak professional basketball player who played in the WNBA and FIBA EuroLeague Women. She played for a team in Slovakia. She competed for Czechoslovakia in the women's tournament at the 1992 Summer Olympics.
